assumptions.statement: The delete-schema confirm text 'N loaded resource(s) of this type will also be deleted.' in group-detail-page.component.ts stays as it is, because spec.md AC-8 / DEC-4 name exactly three texts that change.
assumptions.default_chosen: Text left unchanged. It does not match the FR-011 search 'resource type' because it says 'resource(s) of this type'.
assumptions.rationale: User-visible texts the spec does not spell out are the owner's call. AC-8 lists three changed texts and data-model.md's Frontend table names no others.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: The owner may want this text to say 'schema' as well. That is a one-line template change in group-detail-page.component.ts.

assumptions.statement: The CSS modifier class 'resources-panel__td--type' on the schema-name cell keeps its name, because it is a styling hook, not an identifier of the renamed concept.
assumptions.default_chosen: Class name unchanged, so the SCSS file is not touched.
assumptions.rationale: Keeps the change to the names in data-model.md. The FR-011 search for 'resourceType' / 'resources/types' / 'resource type' does not match this class.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: Renaming it later is a small change to the template and the SCSS file, with no behaviour impact.
